tbesh_html:
: plan
1) to form, fashion, frame
1a) (Qal) to form, fashion
1a1) of human activity
1a2) of divine activity
1a2a) of creation
1a2a1) of original creation
1a2a2) of individuals at conception
1a2a3) of Israel as a people
1a2b) to frame, pre-ordain, plan (fig. of divine) purpose of a situation)
1b) (Niphal) to be formed, be created
1c) (Pual) to be predetermined, be pre-ordained
1d) (Hophal) to be formed

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution)
strongs_1890.derivation: probably identical with H3334 (יָצַר) (through the squeezing into shape); (compare H3331 (יַצַע));
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] earthen, fashion, form, frame, make(-r), potter, purpose.
